chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 598: Ji Ning's Global Chase & the Seamless Gate's Deadly Response
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate strikes back! With 289 Empyrean Gods forming a Daofather-level formation, Ji Ning's reckless hit-and-run across the Grand Worlds has put a massive target on his back.
og_title: The Hunt Begins: 289 Empyrean Gods Want Ji Ning Dead
og_description: Ji Ning's rampage against Seamless Gate lairs triggers a massive counter-deployment. Can he escape the 289-strong formation that can challenge a Daofather?
twitter_title: The Seamless Gate assembles an army against Ji Ning!
twitter_description: The Godking has had enough! 289 Empyrean Gods and True Immortals are on his tail. Can Ji Ning outrun a force that can fight a Daofather?

lore_anchors.definition: The composite universe formed from the shattered remains of the Pangu and Seamless Chaosworlds.
A supreme True Immortal who has mastered a Grand Dao, representing the pinnacle of combat power in the Three Realms.
A Fiendgod Body Refiner who has successfully overcome the Empyrean Tribulation, possessing a nigh-immortal body.
A Ki Refiner who has achieved perfect unity of their energies, transforming into a pure yang being.
A high-tier war formation capable of allowing hundreds of Empyrean Gods to fight as one, rivaling a Daofather.
A heavily fortified war-construct that can withstand sustained Daofather-level attacks.
A treasure capable of tearing through the void to travel between Grand Worlds at immense speed.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, often used for perception and detection.
Patriarch Bodhi's signature divine ability, allowing him to monitor events across the entire Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How many Empyrean Gods and True Immortals did Ji Ning kill so far?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In this chapter, the Seamless Gate confirms a total of 9 kills from the initial ambush, plus 3 more in the Heaven's Direction Grand World, and 6 more from his subsequent rampage, for a provisional total of 18.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Can Ji Ning beat the 289-strong formation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. The formation is strong enough to challenge a true Daofather. Ji Ning's only advantage was speed, and against this army, he is forced to flee.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't a Daofather just kill Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the Nuwa Alliance's Daofathers are watching. If a Seamless Gate Daofather acts directly, a Nuwa Alliance Daofather like Buddha or Three Purities would immediately intervene.
